grader.scenario: Fibre ONT Ethernet port 1 failing to auto-negotiate at 1 Gbps with third-party router; resolved via LAN port 2 remap
grader.notes: Okay call where agent was rude and unhelpful initially regarding third-party router, redeemed by port 2 remapping with handled empathy in the middle third and repeat in the final third.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net full fibre technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Malcolm throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I understand how intensely frustrating it is to pay for gigabit speeds and find your connection restricted...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
